theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds Need Big Money to Start
body: Actually, you can begin investing with small amounts. Regular contributions, no matter the size, build wealth over time through consistency.
caption: Many believe mutual fund investing requires large lump sums upfront. This is a common misconception. Systematic approaches allow flexibility to invest what suits your situation. Start small, invest regularly, stay committed. #MutualFundMyths #InvestingBasics #WealthBuilding #SmallStepsCount #InvestmentTruths
